outcome: duration of latency period between PPROM and delivery
cohort: 592 cases of very early PPROM out of 119,888 deliveries
finding: In the period 2000-2020, there was an improvement in the outcomes of very early PPROM cases and perinatal mortality showed a clear trend to decrease.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean deliveries among the very early PPROM cases was 52.5%.
